Script instruction counter keyed per factory instance instead of per class (Rhino Context is thread-local and was accumulating across all scripts)

stripUrlOptions() removes Legado ',{"webView":true}' suffixes before URI parsing

TOC pagination past the item cap keeps read chapters instead of throwing
SourceHttp: HTTP/2 first with automatic HTTP/1.1 retry on stalled streams; read timeout 20s

curator: carry over untested published sources + fixed CMS seed so a nightly run cannot shrink the bundle
